Item No.1718 Court No.15 Se
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Criminal Appeal No(s).915-916/2023
 Laxmanbhai @ Lakhabhai Pratapbhai Thakor & Anr. Appel
 Versus
 The State Of Gujarat & Ors.
These appeals were called on for hearing today.
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Mehta

[In Chambers]
 For Appellant(s) Mr. Siddhant Sharma, Aor
 Mr. Prafull Bhardwaj, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Ms. Swati Ghildiyal, Aor
 Ms. Srujana Suman Mund, Adv.
 Ms. Neha Singh, Adv.
 Ms. Abhipsa Mohanty, Adv.
 Ms. Rishi Yadav, Adv.
 Ms. Sneha Menon, Adv.

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R

The appellants and the accused Pratap Valabhai Thakor(respondent no. 2 in the High Court) were tried for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 306 and 114 of IPC and Sections 3 & 7 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

The State of Gujarat, preferred an appeal for assailing the acquittal of the accused persons and the High Court vide judgment dated 12th December, 2012 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 578 of 2008 reversed the judgment of the trial court and convicted the appellants and Pratap Valabhai Thakor for the offences mentioned 17:04:23 IST

sentences.text:
This Court is apprised that respondent No.2 herein, namely, Pratap Valabhai Thakor,
expired after the judgment of the High Court but owing to the procedural requirements, his name was mentioned in the array of parties as Respondent No.2.
A death certificate has been filed on record in affirmation of the fact that respondent No. 2 has passed away.
However, on perusal of the death certificate, there is an apparent discrepancy in the name mentioned in the certificate and the name of respondent No. 2.
Notwithstanding the said discrepancy, it is undisputed that respondent No. 2 being a co-accused in the matter, is not a contesting party in these appeals.
Hence the name of the respondent No.2 is struck off from the array of parties.

Amended memo of parties has already been filed, which is taken on record.
(KANCHAN CHOUHAN) (RAM SUBHAG SINGH)
SENIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT COURT MASTER (NSH)
